scope: Two independent HF fp32 reference cases, 200 forced decoder inputs per case including BOS; native T5/cross projection, same delayed history. 1764 live and 36 delay codebook rows per case. Three measured repetitions after one warmup.
decision: Original int8 candidate fails quality comparison against q8 CPU; no promotion. Precision alternatives and Indic validation still in progress.
limitations: Candidate uses f32 GGUF and CPU T5/prefill, distinct from the q8/Metal-prefill performance configuration.
This is teacher-forced distribution quality; no perceptual or free-running speech equivalence is established.
Native T5/cross projection is outside decoder timing and may differ from stored HF cross states.
Compiled model weights are identified by the separately retained export artifacts; this summary is not a portable model bundle.
